text: This landing gives AsyncWait an ImapInputStreamCallback wrapper that owns the protocol callback reference. OnInputStreamReady still forwards directly; when the wrapper is destroyed, it transfers that reference to NS_ReleaseOnMainThread rather than releasing the protocol through its member on the wrapper's destruction thread. The actual protocol callback signals the IMAP loop, while current protocol shutdown/destruction has main-thread constraints and owns a load-info reference. This is a concrete ownership/release boundary, not proof that readiness runs on the main thread or all shutdown races are fixed. No paired Gecko scheduler/LoadInfo implementation, native reproduction or new test was executed.
title: The IMAP IDLE wrapper separates readiness forwarding from protocol-reference release
